claims.text: The datasets used are the LibriSpeech corpus and the GlobalPhone corpus.
LibriSpeech corpus contains 960 hours of English audio with 2.2 million segments for training.
GlobalPhone corpus includes French, German, Czech, and Spanish as low-resource target languages.
20 thousand segments for each language from GlobalPhone were used to calculate average cosine similarity.
